mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_status_log (id, order_no, from_status, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, from_status, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, remark, create_time FROM order_status_log WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id ASC
